	}
}

# oe_mer2.2 — Free Companies Threaten to Sack a City (binds 501_oe_mer2_rebel_demands)
oe_mer2.2 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_mer2.2.title
	desc = oe_mer2.2.desc
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_siege_walls.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	immediate = {
		oe_mer2_spawn_mutineer_rebels = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_mer2.2.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_mer2.2.a.tt
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels }
			apply_rebel_demands = scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
			destroy_rebel = scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_mer2.2.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_mer2.2.b.tt
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_mer2_target_loc }
			scope:oe_mer2_target_loc = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_mer2_sacked_city_loc
					years = 5
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		oe_mer2_rally_mutineer_loc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels }
			scope:oe_mer2_mutineer_rebels = {
				add_rebel_progress = 0.45
			}
		}
		add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
	}
}

# oe_mer2.11 — W3 Read-Only Audit Telemetry (Dev Panel Page 75)
oe_mer2.11 = {
	type = country_event
	orphan = yes
	title = oe_mer2.11.title
	desc = oe_mer2.11.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_diplomacy.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_arrears_risk value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_condottieri }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_charter value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_swiss }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_charter value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_landsknechte }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_charter value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_stradioti }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_charter value = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_kriegsunternehmer }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_charter value = 5 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_charter value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_mer2_free_company_mutiny }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_mutiny value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_mutiny value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_royal_cannon_foundry }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_foundry value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_foundry value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_standing_army_reformed }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_reformed value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_audit_reformed value = 0 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_mer2.11.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_mer2.11.a.tt
	}
}
